title: The Escapists 2 Items
description: Ads items & weapons from The Escapists 2
body:
I added some items from The Escapists 2 in Minecraft. At the moment, there are only 14 weapons available, 7 of which were added in v0.1:
- Baseball Bat
- Super Baseball Bat
- Baton
- Metal Baton
- Super Metal Baton
- Whip
- Super Whip

![Items on top bar — needs to be renamed, to get the items from the bottom bar.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a720692ca477ddb0560e560d30608f51cc6df72.png)

And 7 more in v0.2:
- Plastic Fork
- Plastic Knife
- Plastic Spoon
- Knuckle Duster
- Super Knuckle Duster
- Iron Bar
- Cattle Prod

![Items on top bar — needs to be renamed, to get the items from the bottom bar.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dcab2359b8ef5c5655c3b3add234bb1bf94ba78f.png)

In my plans — add at least about 30 more items in addition to the existing ones in the near future. The pack also supports English and Russian languages.
